newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares end up correcting Monday's fall.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares end up correcting Monday's fall.

text.p: Greek equities oscillated in the 927-931 channel for most of the session closing 0.41 percent higher correcting Monday's overreaction to the release of the first polls showing a tight race between the two major parties.
"The market corrected yesterday's overreaction to the first polls showing a close race between the conservatives and the socialists," said Yannis Kalogerakis, head of trading at ABN-AMRO Securities.

The Athens general share index closed 0.41 percent, or 3.77 points higher at 931.13 from Monday's 927.36 close after opening at 926.84 points. Turnover eased to 7.62 billion drachmas on volume of 3.99 million shares.

Two polls by private polling companies MRB and PRC showed that the conservative New Democracy party and socialist PASOK were neck-and-neck going into the final stretch with small parties on the Left recording gains.
The MRB poll put the conservatives ahead with 31 percent to the socialists' 30.6 percent but the PRC poll placed the socialists in front with 32.8 percent to 31.9 percent for the conservatives.
Greece will hold early elections September 22.
